Want to work in an English-speaking country? Business English is an essential skill that allows you to converse naturally with your colleagues. As a management consultant, I know the importance of building relationships and communicating with clients. Let me help you master your business English through an industry-tailored lesson. I will be offering two types of lessons: business English practice and presentation coaching.

Our business English practice will take us through your industry (IT systems, data science, finance, healthcare, oil & gas, art & design and many more). We will learn how to structure your communication in a logical way. I will also act as your personalized career coach to guide you through the recruiting process for firms, including email etiquette, networking, and relationship building.

We will talk about presentation etiquette, how to structure your discussions, and how to tell stories effectively. I have three years of presentation coaching experience, so I will help you learn speaking patterns that are desired in an English-language interview or executive meeting.

If any of these learning outcomes interest you, I encourage you to book a session with me to experience a positive and exciting learning environment!

I always take notes during our conversations. I like the spend the back half of our sessions reviewing notes on grammar, sentence structure and pronunciation. This feedback will be shared with you each class so that you have the chance to review after class.

pro_course_detail.title: 📊 Simulated Case or Behavioral Interview Preparation

Have an interview coming up? I can simulate a real-life English-language interview environment for you. I will tailor our interview to the job or school program that you are applying for. You will receive detailed feedback and recommendations from me at the end of our session.

What is a case interview? A case interview is used to test your problem-solving skills and logical reasoning. Your job is to solve a case with structure and data-driven insights. I have given 300+ case interviews, so I can help you master your critical reasoning capabilities.

What is a behavioral interview? A behavioral interview is used to learn about your leadership, communication and teamwork abilities. Your job is to describe your past experiences with detail and precision. A behavioral interview is the most common type of interview.

I have extensive interview experience, having received offers from McKinsey & Company, KPMG, PwC, HSBC, RBC, BMO and many more. If you need to polish up your resume, this lesson also includes resume review services. If this sounds helpful to you, don't hesitate to book a class with me!

1. Listen - you will be sent an audio track with a one to two minute conversation filled with idioms and expressions that are commonly used by native speakers. You will need to listen to the main points of the conversation by focusing on the context. This will help your listening skills by teaching you to focus on words that you know to understand general meanings and main ideas. During this part, it is recommended that you take notes in order to prepare for the class. 

2. Learn - I will teach you what the idioms and expressions mean by using the context of the conversation as a guide. I will give you examples and explanations of other situations they can be used in as well. 

3, Speak - you will get the chance to use what you have learned in conversations during the class. This will give you practice and ensure that you can use the new expressions and phrases correctly. 

After the class has ended, I will get you to listen to the audio track again. At this point, you will be able to understand the complete conversation. After that, I will ask you to take a quiz based on the lesson for homework. In addition to that, you can send me sentences using the new expressions and idioms to give you some extra practice. It is recommended that you review the lessons at different intervals to help you retain the material that was taught.

Through these classes, you will hear and learn how English is really spoken in business and everyday life!

If you would like any additional information or to talk with me, send me a message on italki or book a trial class with me.
